instruction: Make copies of slides 12 and 13, and place the duplicates immediately after slide 13.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires duplicating slides 12 and 13 (0-based: slides 11 and 12) and placing them after slide 13. Original has 24 slides, result should have 26. Verified slide positions: slides 12 and 13 contain 'Title of container' and 'Other contributors' content. Custom getter extracts slide structure and text content, metric verifies correct count and content duplication.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: slide count increases from 24 to 26 slides
Metric correctly identifies expected duplicate positions (indices 13 and 14) after original slides at indices 11 and 12
Getter extracts slide text content appropriately using python-pptx library
Postconfig includes file save (Ctrl+S) to ensure state is persisted before verification
Text content comparison logic correctly matches original slides at indices 11,12 with copies at indices 13,14
Partial credit scoring is reasonable: 0.5 for correct slide count, 0.5 for content matching
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter only extracts first 5 text elements per slide (line 43: texts[:5]). For slides with more than 5 text elements, differences could be missed. Consider extracting all text elements or increasing the limit.
Metric could be more robust by also verifying that original slides at positions 11 and 12 remain unchanged (currently only checks that copies exist at positions 13-14)

Consider adding edge case handling: what if slides have no text content? Currently would compare empty lists, which might pass incorrectly for slides that should have different non-text content (images, shapes, etc.)
